preconditions.description: The integer n is a positive integer within the range of 1 to 10^5.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= f(i) <= n for all i in [1, n]
preconditions.description: Each value f(i) in the sequence is a positive integer within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: m == -1 if no solution exists else 1 <= m <= 10^6
postconditions.description: The output m is -1 if no solution exists, otherwise it is a positive integer within the range of 1 to 10^6.
The function g composed with h returns the identity function for all x in the range [m].
The function h composed with g returns the original function f for all x in the range [n].

postconditions.expression: m != -1 implies g and h exist and are valid
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, then there are functions g and h that satisfy the given conditions.
